outcome: Time from 4 cm cervical dilation to vaginal delivery
cohort: Nulliparous women with a term, singleton gestation and intact membranes who presented for induction of labor (January 2008 to December 2011)
finding: Early AROM was not associated with an increased rate of chorioamnionitis overall but was associated with an increased cesarean section rate, while among women who delivered vaginally, AROM < 4 cm decreased the rate of chorioamnionitis and the time from 4 cm dilation to vaginal delivery.
mod_finding: Early artificial amniotomy was associated with an increased rate of cesarean section but a decreased rate of chorioamnionitis among those who delivered vaginally.
